name: Family Getaway Finder
tagline: Shortlists family stays with free cancellation around your real dates
description: Finds places a family can actually stay for a weekend or a three-to-four-night break, and only suggests options that come with free cancellation. If a child's sports fixture fixes the dates, it builds the trip around that game instead of making you work backwards. It stops at the shortlist; you book and pay.
author: antoniostoner
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
